Full release notes: **https://danbyte.net/news/v0-16-0**

### New in 0.16.3

#### Fixed

- **The upgrade's health check reaches the right site.** The final probe asked `https://127.0.0.1/` and the bare app port with no host name. On a box where Danbyte is not nginx's default server that lands on someone else's server block, and the app port answers a nameless plain-HTTP request with a redirect, so a working upgrade was reported as failed and rolled back. The probe now carries a host name from `ALLOWED_HOSTS` and says it came over HTTPS, then tries nginx on 443 with the same name; `/api/health/` is also exempt from the HTTPS redirect.
- **A failure after the migration keeps the new code.** The scripts promised this in a comment and then checked out the old commit anyway, leaving old code running on a new schema. Now the code only goes back when the migration has not run; afterwards the new code stays, and the status says so and names the Before-upgrade backup as the way back.
- **Upgrade failures quote the real error.** Each step's stderr is captured and its tail lands in the status the Updates page shows, so a bad wheel, a truncated bundle or the migration traceback is visible where the failure is reported instead of one fixed sentence per step. (#185)
- **Failed upgrades no longer fill the disk.** Automatic updates retried a failed release every 20 minutes, each try taking another full database and media backup that nothing pruned. The timer now leaves a release it failed on alone until a person retries or the next release moves the target, and Before-upgrade backups keep only the newest three (a protected one is never pruned).
